Throughout the declared ceasefire, Israel has continued targeting Hamas in Gaza. Those attacks

Kat Lonsdorf, NPR News, Tel Aviv.
Stocks on Wall Street rallied this week as investors shrugged off high energy prices
and bond yields. NPR's Scott Horsley reports all of the major stock indices ended the week
in positive territory. Retail fuel prices eased a little bit this week, but it still cost a lot
to fill up a car or a truck or a commercial jetliner. Delta Airline says higher fuel prices
took a bite out of profits during the most recent quarter. Pepsi is also facing higher
cost and plans to compensate by raising prices for its soda pop and snack foods.

Canney's appointment seems to be part of the center's current push away from the kind of
